comments: Monasteries composing the La stod Byang stong skor after the Hor invasion are listed in [Y2ZN5C6X] (cited in [4LDAV8UH]: 103): "Drag chung, Chos skdings, Zo lung, Spang dmar, Khro phu, Rgyal thang, Bye khud, Rta mkhar, Rta rga, 'Thing chung, Gyu mo, Glang ri, Dmig mangs, Wa ri, Sha cha, Spe ra, Yul lu chung, Dben sa, and Thar gling pa."
